implications.impact: Load forecast changes affect procurement volumes and SABESS viability. Higher forecast = more storage need.
Transmission constraints in northern pocket (Fort Lupton) affect interconnection timing and headroom.
Storage procurement volumes and bid economics shape competitive landscape.
Deferred 608 MW wind bid. Re-approval affects RFP competition and Phase II resource mix.
Comanche 3 repair timeline affects near-term capacity need and JTS Phase II urgency.
Generic cost changes (capital, O&M) affect SABESS cost competitiveness in RFP evaluation.
ELCC curves determine storage accreditation. Storage over-accreditation was corrected in April 2026 filing.
Fort Lupton not a JT community (Pueblo, Morgan County are). Less relevant but monitor for scope changes.
High curtailment of renewables increases storage value for energy shifting and grid support.
Present Value Revenue Requirement changes affect cost-benefit analysis for SABESS vs. alternatives.

Deferred 608 MW wind bid. Re-approval affects RFP competition and Phase II resource mix.
Comanche 3 repair timeline affects near-term capacity need and JTS Phase II urgency.
Generic cost changes (capital, O&M) affect SABESS cost competitiveness in RFP evaluation.
Interconnection studies, provisional service, or headroom constraints directly impact Fort Lupton SABESS.
ELCC curves determine storage accreditation. Storage over-accreditation was corrected in April 2026 filing.
Fort Lupton not a JT community (Pueblo, Morgan County are). Less relevant but monitor for scope changes.
High curtailment of renewables increases storage value for energy shifting and grid support.
